name: random_trader
summary: This EA opens a single position at a time with a random direction (buy or sell), using either a fixed pip distance or ATR-based stop loss and take profit. It includes a breakeven mechanism and risk-based lot sizing with margin validation, but the core entry logic is purely random with no market analysis.
summary_zh: 这个EA每次随机选择买入或卖出方向开仓，使用固定点数或ATR止损止盈距离。包含保本机制和基于风险的仓位计算及保证金验证，但核心入场逻辑完全是随机的，没有任何市场分析。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是随机入场交易，通过MathRand()函数生成0或1来决定买入或卖出方向，完全没有技术分析或市场判断。入场条件仅依赖于当前是否无持仓（PositionsTotal()==0），只要没有持仓就随机开仓。出场条件通过止损和止盈实现，止损可基于固定点数或ATR指标计算，止盈则按设定的盈亏比计算。仓位管理方面，使用账户余额百分比计算风险仓位大小，并根据保证金充足性调整手数，支持使用最大可用保证金。保本机制在价格朝有利方向移动指定点数后将止损移至开仓价。整体而言，这是一个随机交易工具而非策略性EA，长期来看期望收益接近零扣除点差后为负。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is purely random entry trading, using MathRand() to generate 0 or 1 to decide buy or sell direction with zero technical analysis or market judgment. Entry conditions depend solely on whether there is no existing position (PositionsTotal()==0), opening a random trade whenever the account is flat. Exit conditions are implemented through stop loss and take profit, where stop loss can be based on fixed pip distance or ATR indicator, and take profit is calculated using the configured reward/risk ratio. Position sizing uses account balance percentage for risk-based lot calculation, adjusts lot size based on margin availability, and supports using maximum available margin when required margin is insufficient. The breakeven mechanism moves stop loss to the entry price after price moves favorably by a specified pip distance. Overall, this is a random trading tool rather than a strategic EA, with expected long-term returns approaching zero minus spread costs being negative.

parameters.name: reward_risk_ratio
parameters.description: 盈亏比，止盈距离与止损距离的比率
parameters.description_en: Reward-to-risk ratio: TP distance vs SL distance

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: 止损模式选择：PIP(固定点数)或ATR(基于ATR指标)
parameters.description_en: Stop-loss mode: PIP (fixed points) or ATR-based

parameters.name: loss_atr
parameters.description: ATR止损乘数，ATR值乘以该系数作为止损距离
parameters.description_en: ATR stop-loss multiplier applied to ATR value

parameters.name: loss_pip
parameters.description: 固定点数止损距离，以pip为单位

parameters.name: risk_percent_per_trade
parameters.description: 每笔交易风险百分比，基于账户余额计算仓位
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade, sizes position from balance

parameters.name: use_breakeven
parameters.description: 是否启用保本机制，盈利达到指定距离后将止损移至开仓价
parameters.description_en: Enable breakeven: moves SL to entry after specified distance

parameters.name: breakeven_distance
parameters.description: 保本激活距离，以pip为单位

parameters.name: use_max_margin
parameters.description: 保证金不足时是否使用最大可用保证金调整仓位
parameters.description_en: Use maximum available margin to adjust lot size when insufficient

pros: 完善的仓位验证机制，包含止损级别、冻结级别和保证金检查
基于风险的仓位计算，根据账户余额百分比和止损距离动态调整手数
保本机制可以有效保护已有盈利，降低亏损风险
代码结构清晰，使用类封装交易验证逻辑，可维护性较好
ATR止损模式可以自适应市场波动率变化
pros_en: Comprehensive order validation mechanism including stop level, freeze level, and margin checks
Risk-based position sizing that dynamically adjusts lot size based on account balance percentage and stop loss distance
Breakeven mechanism effectively protects existing profits and reduces loss risk
Clean code structure using class encapsulation for trade validation logic, good maintainability
ATR-based stop loss mode can adapt to changing market volatility
cons: 入场逻辑完全随机，没有任何市场分析依据，长期必然亏损
每次只允许一个持仓，错失其他交易机会且无法对冲
pip_point计算不完整，未处理digits为0、1、6等非标准情况
止损级别计算中硬编码了10*point的额外偏移，缺乏透明度和可配置性
保本机制未考虑交易成本(点差和手续费)，移至开仓价实际可能仍亏损
tiket变量在EA重启后不会持久化，可能丢失持仓跟踪
cons_en: Entry logic is completely random with no market analysis basis, guaranteed long-term loss after spread costs
Only one position allowed at a time, missing other trading opportunities and unable to hedge
Pip point calculation is incomplete, not handling non-standard digits values like 0, 1, or 6
Stop level calculation has hardcoded 10*point extra offset, lacking transparency and configurability
Breakeven mechanism doesn't account for trading costs (spread and commission), moving to entry price may still result in loss
The tiket variable is not persisted across EA restarts, potentially losing position tracking
improvements: 添加技术分析入场信号替代随机入场，如均线交叉、RSI超买超卖等，使策略具有正期望收益
在保本机制中将止损移至开仓价加上点差和手续费成本，确保真正保本
补充pip_point计算对非标准digits的处理，并使止损级别的额外偏移可配置
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add technical analysis entry signals to replace random entry, such as MA crossover or RSI overbought/oversold, giving the strategy positive expected value
Move stop loss to entry price plus spread and commission costs in breakeven mechanism to ensure true breakeven
Complete pip_point calculation for non-standard digits and make the stop level extra offset configurable
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high spread and low liquidity periods

risk_points: 随机入场没有分析依据，长期统计上必亏（扣除点差后期望收益为负）
无新K线检查机制，每个tick都可能尝试开仓，可能在不利时机重复尝试
保本机制未考虑交易成本，实际可能仍处于亏损状态
EA重启后tiket变量重置，可能导致持仓管理丢失
risk_points_en: Random entry without analytical basis, statistically guaranteed long-term loss after spread deduction (negative expected value)
No new bar check mechanism, may attempt to open positions on every tick potentially at unfavorable moments
Breakeven mechanism doesn't account for trading costs, may still be in a loss position
The tiket variable resets on EA restart, potentially causing loss of position management
